json.content: My brother flew in from Denver this weekend, first time since March. Marcus and I drove out to the Palisades Saturday morning, and forty minutes into the hike my brother calls from the PT waiting room because he can't find the medication note. I'd sent him the whole schedule before he came, it's been in the notes tab since March. So I'm standing on the trail walking him through the Lisinopril timing while Marcus keeps going and waits up ahead
